description: The case study's call to action must be a single fully qualified URL with all three UTM parameters, and never a link shortener.

input.situation: A multi-entity group ran eight entities on fourteen ERPs and could not consolidate to one truth.
input.approach: Canvas Intelligence built one governed consolidation architecture across all entities, ERPs and currencies.
input.result: 8 entities / 3 countries / 4 currencies consolidated into one governed architecture

rubric.criterion: CTA URL is fully qualified with UTM parameters
rubric.condition: The case study contains exactly one URL starting with https://www.canvasintelligence.com/ carrying utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign.

rubric.criterion: Roof line closes the case study
rubric.condition: The last non-empty line of the case study is exactly the string: Your Data. Delivered.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md hard rules 3 and 4.
